definitions.gloss: master of ceremonies; moderator; emcee; host
definitions.explanation: A person who presides over and facilitates an event, meeting, ceremony, or program. Responsible for introductions, keeping things on schedule, and guiding the flow of proceedings.

examples.japanese: {司会者|しかいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{司会者|しかいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to be the emcee at a wedding.

examples.japanese: {司会者|しかいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the emcee is skilled, the atmosphere of the whole event improves.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{司会|しかい}→司会：00364_shikai⟧ (emceeing, presiding) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to the person who hosts or moderates events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {司会者|しかいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as emcee
- {司会者|しかいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask someone to be emcee
- {司会者|しかいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧: the emcee's facilitation

USAGE:
⟦{司会|しかい}→司会：00364_shikai⟧ alone can also mean "emceeing" or be used as a suru-verb (⟦{司会|しかい}→司会：00364_shikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to emcee). {司会者|しかいしゃ} specifically emphasizes the person performing the role.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{司会|しかい}→司会：00364_shikai⟧: emceeing, hosting — the act itself or used as a role label
- ⟦{進行役|しんこうやく}→進行役：25039_shinkouyaku⟧: facilitator — emphasizes the role of keeping things moving forward
- MC（エムシー）: MC — borrowed from English, used especially in entertainment and variety shows
